title: Orders
lead: Ticket orders, newest first. Open one to see who comes on each ticket, to cancel it, or to link a ticket to a guest on your list.
refused: Your role on this event can’t see orders.
emailsHidden: Buyers’ email addresses aren’t shown to your role.

detail.refused: Your role on this event can’t see who is on an order.
detail.gone: This order is no longer on the event.
detail.cancelling: Being cancelled: waiting for the bank. Nobody on it can be let in meanwhile.
detail.hidden: Contacts and ticket codes aren’t shown to your role.
detail.guestUnknown: the guest list can’t be read
detail.guestNotListed: a guest no longer on the list

cancel.guests: takes the people on it off the event’s answers and frees their seats
cancel.whole: If anyone can still come, they buy again.

refusals.admitted: Someone on this order was already let in, so it can’t be cancelled: settle it with the buyer.
refusals.notPaid: This order isn’t paid, so there is nothing to cancel.
refusals.forbidden: Only someone who manages the organization’s money can cancel orders.
refusals.gone: This order is no longer on the event.
refusals.bankUnknown: The bank didn’t answer about the refund. The order stays frozen until Aveline confirms it with the bank: don’t refund it another way.
refusals.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
refusals.noAnswer: No answer came back. Press again: it never refunds twice.

link.title: Link {{holder}}’s ticket to a guest on your list
link.lead: The guest keeps their own answers; what was typed at checkout is kept aside. The ticket’s code doesn’t change.
link.noGuests: The guest list couldn’t be loaded.
link.noGuestsRole: Your role can’t read the guest list.

register.title: Register who holds this ticket
register.lead: This ticket was sold before each ticket named its person. Name them here, as checkout asks; the code doesn’t change.
register.leadNamed: Bought by {{holder}} before each ticket named its person. Name who holds it, as checkout asks; the code doesn’t change.
register.unpublished: Publish the announcement first: this reads the questions checkout asks from it.
register.failed: What checkout asks couldn’t be read. Close and try again.

refusals.changed: The ticket’s link changed meanwhile. The order was read again.
refusals.hasTicket: That guest already holds a ticket.
refusals.erased: An erased person can’t be linked.
refusals.invited: This ticket already belongs to an invited guest, who can’t be replaced.
refusals.history: The guest checkout made already has seats, an admission, an agreement or messages: settle those first.
refusals.staffReview: This needs Aveline staff to review the admission records.
refusals.notActive: Only an active ticket of a paid order can be reconciled.
refusals.hasAttendee: This ticket already has a person: link a guest instead.
refusals.staleRevision: The hosts changed how guests answer meanwhile. The questions were read again: answer again.
refusals.forbidden: Your role can’t change the guest list.
refusals.gone: This ticket is no longer on the event.
refusals.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
refusals.noAnswer: No answer came back. Press again.
